name: Curve DEX

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The exact same bare EOA is both the AMM factory’s admin() and the fee-receiver/x-gov vault’s owner(), so one key controls the DEX’s parameters and its protocol fees.
narrative.detail: Confirmed via eth_getCode: 0 bytecode, a bare EOA. Only checked against the single official Robinhood Chain mainnet RPC so far; a second-RPC cross-check attempt 404’d, so this is flagged single-source rather than presented as this project’s usual 2-RPC-confirmed standard. Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20: the same bare EOA (0xabc336d4…1cbF) is also the StableSwap factory admin on Monad, so crossExposureScore is folded to a flat 80 (composite unchanged). An identical EOA address is the identical key, and the flag is a dated claim confirmed by the cross-ecosystem sweep script, not a live read of Monad.

steps.what: admin() on the contract: the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (1 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# admin() on the contract: the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x8271e06e5887fe5ba05234f5315c19f3ec90e8ad","data":"0xf851a440"},"0x5416c47"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (1 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","0x5416c47"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 88173313 and 88173639 of the chain

reproduce.note: this RPC cannot replay the block of the build (it ignores the block tag, or no longer serves old state): the call reproduces the current value, not the one of the build; compare the composite and lastUpdated with this page

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key, 1 transactions sent; delay: none
